title: Next-Best Product
tagline: Recommending the right product for every customer
intro: A model that looks at each customer and ranks our six products by how likely they are to buy them.
sample_note: Demo built on synthetic data for a fictional subscription business. All figures are illustrative.

products.desc: Extra storage space for files and photos, billed monthly.
why: They visit often (the strongest signal)
They use the app on a phone
They open and click our emails
They are newer, younger customers

products.desc: Faster, dedicated help when something goes wrong.
why: They have contacted support recently (the strongest signal)
They spend more per order
They have been a customer for longer

products.desc: The top subscription tier, with every feature included.
why: They spend more per order (the strongest signal)
They have been a customer for longer
They visit often
They pay close to full price rather than on discount

products.desc: Switching from monthly to yearly billing at a lower overall price.
why: They have been a customer for longer (the strongest signal)
They have bought from us several times
They are offered a discount

products.desc: One plan shared by up to five people in a household.
why: They already hold several of our products (the strongest signal)
They are in an older age band
They shop in store

products.desc: Prepaid credit to give to someone else.
why: It is late in the year (the strongest signal)
They shop in store
They have bought from us before

families.name: Driven by engagement
families.why: How actively they visit, read and get in touch

families.name: Driven by price & value
families.why: What they spend and the price they are offered

families.name: Driven by the customer
families.why: Who the customer is and how long they have been with us

families.name: Driven by history
families.why: What they already hold and how recently they bought

families.name: Driven by context
families.why: The segment, device and timing of the interaction

next.title: Pilot in the app, then roll out
next.text: Show the top suggestion to one in ten app users for six weeks, compare uptake with a control group, then extend to the website and stores.

close.notes: Close on the four takeaways, then the pilot plan. This is a demo: every number is synthetic.
